title: Market diversity versus forecasting performance
scope: All eligible exact clean-LLM configurations on non-imputed Polymarket rows. Model version aliases are merged, while information and prompt conditions remain separate.

total_variation.label: Total variation (TV)
total_variation.formula: mean(abs(p_model - p_market)) on original paired Bernoulli probabilities

prediction_diversity.label: Prediction diversity
prediction_diversity.higher_means: less linear alignment with the freeze-time market probability

raw_brier.label: Brier Score
raw_brier.formula: mean over events of the within-event mean squared probability error
raw_brier.weighting: equal events; equal targets within each event

encoding.market_line: support-weighted mean of each selected configuration's matched-market score; each tooltip also reports its exact matched-market score

imputation_audit.policy: exclude a scored Polymarket row only when every matched original ForecastBench source forecast has imputed=true

audit.brier_score_weighting: equal events; equal targets within event
